errors.text_span: The bars are grouped by Block Index, with each group containing two bars representing 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit configurations, colored blue and green, respectively.
errors.evidence: The chart is not a grouped bar chart. Each Block Index has only a single bar, which is either blue (4-Fbit) or green (2-Fbit). The description fundamentally misinterprets the chart's structure.
The data values on the vertical axis extend above 10^-4. The description itself later correctly identifies the maximum value as being around 1.3 x 10^-4, which contradicts the stated range.

errors.text_span: For Block Index values 27 to 63, both 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit bars are visible
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect and hallucinates data. For any given Block Index, only one bar (representing either 4-Fbit or 2-Fbit) is visible, not both.
